rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A TypeScript-based MCP server that provides complete Grafana integration with 43 tools across 13 categories including dashboard management, Prometheus/Loki queries, incident management, alerting, OnCall schedules, Sift investigations, and Pyroscope profiling. Built by Leval AI as a migration from Go to TypeScript/JavaScript with npm distribution, it features multiple authentication methods (service account tokens, API keys, basic auth, mTLS), comprehensive client support for Claude Desktop, VS Code extensions, and other MCP clients, and specialized clients for different Grafana services with proper error handling and debug logging. The implementation offers both full dashboard operations and efficient JSONPath-based property updates, real-time log analysis, metric querying, and incident response workflows, making it ideal for DevOps teams, SREs, and developers who need AI-assisted observability and monitoring operations integrated directly into their development workflow.
